title: Soft maize porridge with milk and honey
summary: Mieliepap the way gogo made it.
steps: Bring water to the boil in a pot, about three times the volume of the maize meal, with a pinch of salt.
Whisk in the maize meal slowly so no lumps form.
Turn the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often, until smooth and thick. Add a splash more water if it gets too stiff.
Spoon it into a bowl, pour over the milk, and top with the sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.
